systems: Nix Hydra: a job is built when its derivation output is not already in the store — keyed on inputs, never on how recently something changed
Bazel: an action reruns when its action-key digest misses the cache, so a failed build is retried on the next invocation by construction — the property the 24h gate lacked, now stated correctly
Launchpad daily recipe builds: a daily build is dispatched only when the recipe branch revision differs from the last built one, the same published-vs-source comparison as tag-vs-HEAD
